criteria.description: A readable workbook contains every requested operating-review sheet.
The source-selection record identifies the only approved, complete 2024Q2 schema-1.1 release.
Consolidated_Data contains exactly the six records from the selected release and no mixed-release records.
All four operating KPIs are formula-driven and equal the independent source replay.
Changing the selected REV-100 bookings input by +100 flows to total bookings by exactly +100.
Changing the selected REV-101 recognized-revenue input by +100 flows to total and South revenue by exactly +100.
Regional record counts and recognized-revenue closures are formulas linked to the six consolidated records.
Every release-registry source field is preserved exactly from release_registry.csv.
The chosen-source reason, four required-region statuses, and evidence labels remain reviewable.
Penalty for any invalid selection, mixed source, hardcoded/broken KPI chain, unlinked coverage, or registry alteration.
